title: Air flow is lower than our other cooler
text:
Air flow is lower than our other cooler. I have a big swamp cooler like this one from Keystone that significantly out performs this one in a couple of ways. This one isn't bad, but it does not move much air despite the oscillating vent. I can feel the air flow from 25 feet away on the Keystone, but 12 feet away from this one and it loses it's oomph.

The thing with these evaporative coolers is they are only effective in limited climate situations. You need real air conditioning in East Texas due to the constant high humidity here, but out at the ranch in West Texas, these can help make you reasonably comfortable. The humidity averages 10 to 15% on most days out there and the evaporative action is noticeable. But again, this particular unit just isn't as cool as the other one - that may be because of the lower air flow, I'm not sure. However, I think it will be fine in conjunction with the other unit in our small cabin.
